mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over a 3-month period signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales of 1% or more over a quarter indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines > 1% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and PAYEMS both decline in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and PAYEMS decline in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a stable unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE stable in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE is stable in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%), signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5pp in 1 month and CPIAUCSL < 2%
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with low inflation
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5pp in 1 month and CPIAUCSL < 2%.
